Pronunciation note for this grammar point:

Most markers of two syllables or more are unstressed except the one that carries the contrast, so however /haʊˈev.ə/ keeps the stress on the second syllable while moreover /mɔːrˈəʊ.və/ keeps it on the second as well.
Read it aloud, then record yourself: the main stress falls on the content word, not on the hedge.

elements.content: Grammar focus: Discourse Markers.

Choose the marker by the relation, then check the punctuation and the register. However and in contrast start a new sentence with a comma after them; although and whereas join clauses inside one sentence. On the contrary contradicts a previous statement, while on the other hand balances two sides, and confusing the two is the most common marker error at this level.

addition — adds a supporting point: furthermore, moreover, in addition
contrast — sets two points against each other: however, in contrast, by comparison
concession — admits a point, keeps the case: admittedly, granted that, even so
sequence — orders the parts: first, subsequently, finally
result — states the consequence: consequently, as a result, therefore
stance — marks the writer's position: arguably, in fact, on the contrary
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Complete: 'The evidence is weak. ___, the conclusion may still hold.'
2. Which marker contradicts the previous statement?
3. Which punctuation is correct?
options: The cost is high; nevertheless, the case is sound.
The cost is high nevertheless the case is sound.

elements.content: Read and listen: three examples in context.

Addition — Moreover, the sample was too small to generalise. (Adds a second point.)
Concession — Admittedly, the cost is high; nevertheless, the case is sound. (Concedes, then holds.)
Conclusion — In conclusion, the policy needs an owner. (Signals the end.)
Reframing — As far as staffing is concerned, the picture is different. (Limits the topic.)
What do you observe?

A discourse marker names the relation between two sentences: addition (furthermore, moreover, in addition), contrast (however, nevertheless, in contrast), concession (admittedly, granted that, even so), sequence (first, subsequently, finally), result (consequently, as a result), and stance (arguably, in fact, roughly speaking). Most take a comma, and fronted ones usually take a comma after them.
1. Which marker concedes a point and then continues to argue?
2. Which order is right for however?
State the rule in one sentence, without looking at the table.

Success criteria:
- I can name the relation before I choose the marker.
- I can punctuate however and therefore correctly.
- I can tell on the contrary from on the other hand.
Role play: put your position in ninety seconds; your partner notes every use of the target structure.
Frequent errors and correction:

❌ The plans were ambitious, however the funding never appeared (comma splice before however) → ✅ The plans were ambitious. However, the funding never appeared
❌ On the other hand, the report says the opposite (opposition instead of contradiction) → ✅ On the contrary, the report says the opposite
Correct these sentences: say what is wrong, then give the right version.
Acceptable variants:

Exports rose; in contrast, domestic demand fell.
Granted that the sample is small, the pattern is consistent.
On the contrary, the evidence points the other way.
